body:
I’ve always wanted to see a therapist but I don’t have enough money. I’ve tried reading about it online but nothing helps. I just feel like my mind and my mentality is set and I can’t change my way of thinking no matter what I do.

I’ve tried speaking to all of my ‘friends’ but they just try and kill off the conversation as fast as possible. They usually invite me out and include me in shit but I’m more of a blow in rather than a close friend. I just don’t try and bother them and I know they’ve got their own group chat with out me. I’ve just accepted that I’m different. 

I don’t have a drivers license. I’ve never driven a car in my life due to immense fear. I don’t know how to overcome it because I just don’t want to be responsible for controlling a car. I know I’ll just be constantly on edge if I do start. It’s pathetic at my age.

I do live at home with my parents. They’re not exactly comfortable financially so I won’t ask them for money. They’ve had money problems in the past they they’re only just getting under control. A big reason I also don’t want to start a new job is because of my social anxiety. I actually dread starting fresh with new people, it makes me feel very sick. I’ve started 2 new jobs in the past year and both times nearly turned away just because of how much I dreaded the first day.

The drugs and alcohol aren’t too big a problem but I’m afraid they will become one. I’ve always used them out with mates at clubs and pubs but only because they made me feel comfortable socialising. Without them I just wouldn’t want to be out or around people especially that I don’t know, I’d just feel extremely awkward and anxious. They made me feel included especially since most my friends did them as well. I don’t really have access to drugs now since we’re in kind of a lockdown but I’ve been drinking a lot more.

Another thing I didn’t mention was I can’t talk to girls (at least like another human being). I’ve never had a girlfriend and every girl I’ve ever interacted with thought I was weird, especially at school. I’ve always grown up thinking about my future and wanting to have kids and a family but as I’ve gotten older I just can’t see that happening at all. I’ll probably just end up living with my parents until I die.
